rationale: C12 is an unmistakable drafting template for the child. It uses the same operative opening formula, the same San Bernardino Meridian land-description structure, an acreage statement, and an effectively verbatim delayed-effect clause specifying 10:00 a.m. on the thirty-fifth day and subsequent disposal under the mining laws. Only the particular tract, acreage, and minor wording change. C04 and C15 share public-land terminology and descriptive machinery, but concern monument reservations and are substantially weaker.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Subject to valid existing rights and to the provisions of existing withdrawals, the following-described land in the Angeles National Forest, California, is hereby opened to location and entry under the mining laws of the United States
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Subject to valid existing rights and to the provisions of existing withdrawals, the following-described land is hereby opened to location and entry under the mining laws of the United States
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive operative language is nearly verbatim, with the child adding the forest and state identification.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This order shall not become effective to change the status of the land until 10:00 a.m. on the thirty-fifth day after the date of this order, at which time the land shall, subject to the provisions of this order, become subject to disposal under the mining laws of the United States.
